date_published.why: '2025' is all the sources allow; the presentation date is only 'shortly before 1 May 2025'.

summary_claims.claim: MITIC is the enforcement authority with a National Register of AI Systems; bans AI for indiscriminate surveillance; ethical audits for systems affecting fundamental rights
Provides sanctions, tax incentives, a National Committee on AI Ethics and Regulation and a research centre/education plan

scope.note: The summary now shows prohibitions, audits and sanctions, so the bill is core AI regulation as well as promotion; the earlier scope_note is no longer needed, but may stay.

note: The Chamber's own bulletins (2 May and 27 Oct 2025) support title, five sponsors, content and the committee stage; the bill text itself is blocked. The title differs between bulletins and the extractor handles this in the notes. date_published stays '2025'. Search found no vote; a hearing report of 4 Jun 2025 is the latest item.
